newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnamese girls jump to death from bridge.
newsitem.headline: Vietnamese girls jump to death from bridge.

text.p: Police are investigating a suicide pact in which four teenage girls died after jumping from a bridge into a river on the outskirts of Ho Chi Minh City, formerly Saigon, an officer said on Thursday.

He said by telephone the bodies had been recovered on Monday and Tuesday close to the Xang bridge, in northwest Hoc Mon district, after clothes and other belongings were spotted nearby. The officer said the girls had left home several days earlier. Three of them had their fingers tied together. The fourth was found separately.
"We know it's a suicide. We are trying to find out the exact cause," he said.
Social workers say teenage suicides are rare in Vietnam. Problems are more commonly reflected in delinquency and crime, including prostitution.
